items.question: Which syllable placed at the weapon mantra's end causes the slaying of all beings?
premises: The instruction continues the preceding mantra formula.
The kūrca syllable is uttered thereafter.
The syllable is placed at the end of the weapon mantra.
The utterance is directed toward the slaying of all beings.
items.inference: Uttering the kūrca syllable at the end of the weapon mantra effects the slaying of all beings.
items.plain_english: Then utter the kūrca syllable at the end of the weapon mantra for the slaying of all beings.
